_why: ITEM 5 WANTS A PICTURE PER COMPONENT, 'rendered on a real frame at reference scale'. These fifteen are the ones Builder 2 ported. Every one is a frame of the SAME timeline at the SAME canvas on the SAME corpus fixture, so they are comparable to each other rather than each being its own demo — that is what reference scale buys. The frame was chosen per component from its OWN curves, at the moment its mechanism is legible, and is recorded here with the reason; a frame picked from the middle by habit showed Stack's furniture instead of its plate and is the reason that field exists.
_canvas: 1080x1920 @ 30fps; stills rendered by ChatCut cloud at 882x1568
_fit_note: The nine transitions render `contain` and letterbox like the base track; the four zooms render `cover` under the temporary exception, so a zoom still is full-bleed and a transition still carries bars. That difference is REAL and is visible in these pictures.
